newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Sugen started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Sugen started as buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it initiated coverage of Sugen Inc with a buy and set a $29 price target for the stock.
-- Sees Sugen as one of the best emerging biotechnology companies.
-- Said company is developing a strong North American oncology franchise. Sugen will also be seeking corporate partners for other specialties and other geographic areas.
-- Sees Sugen expanding its clinical portfolio and enhancing shareholder value in 1997
-- Shares were 1/2 higher at 13-1/2 in afternoon trade.
